answer.summary: Revolut gives product teams ownership of weekly progress, while founders maintain unusually close oversight: they provide steering in weekly reviews and review every screen before it ships.

sections.heading: Team ownership and leadership oversight
sections.content: Each week, product owners present directly to the CEO and CTO what their team achieved in the prior week, and receive steering from the founders. At the same time, the founders review 100% of screens before they ship, scrutinizing edge cases and details. So the balance is team ownership of delivery alongside intensive leadership guidance and review—not unchecked autonomy.

judgment.explanation: The answer is supported by S1: product owners present work in weekly reviews, receive founders’ steering, and founders review every screen before shipping. It describes oversight, but omits the key tradeoff that autonomy enables many products to ship without micromanagement and that leadership can challenge teams or intervene when needed.
